t: You're looking at All Saints, a Church of England parish church on Talbot Road in Notting Hill. It's built in Victorian Gothic Revival style, with striking polychromatic decoration, meaning bands and patterns of coloured materials. It's Grade II* listed, and affiliated to the Anglo-Catholic Forward in Faith movement. The architect was William White, who is noted for his part in nineteenth-century Gothic Revival architecture and for his church restorations.
